title: BenchKind
description: bench.kind@1: a benchmark kind on OpenVibe.Bench. ROOM is the room that owns the kind, ENTRY the shape a submitted entry takes, JUDGE the default judge (pair, rubric, automatic_grader, test_suite or game_outcome), NAME the display name, SCHEMA the entry JSON Schema, and METRICS the board metrics (elo, pareto, cost, or a room's own).
